# terrakube_federated_credential_claim (Resource)

Create a claim condition for a federated credential. Claim conditions restrict which tokens are accepted from the identity provider: every condition must match for a token to be authorized. Examples: `repository_owner` (GitHub Actions), `groups_direct` (GitLab CI), `amr` (Azure AD).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "terrakube_federated_credential" "github_actions" {
  name       = "GitHub Actions"
  issuer_url = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  audience   = "terrakube-audience"
}

resource "terrakube_federated_credential_claim" "repository_owner" {
  federated_credential_id = terrakube_federated_credential.github_actions.id
  claim_key               = "repository_owner"
  claim_value             = "terrakube-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_key` (String) Claim key to match in the identity provider token. Example: "repository_owner"
- `claim_value` (String) Expected value for the claim key. Example: "terrakube-org"
- `federated_credential_id` (String) Terrakube federated credential ID this claim condition belongs to

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Federated credential claim ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Federated credential claim can be imported with federated_credential_id,id
terraform import terrakube_federated_credential_claim.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
